mapper.sql: s.sku_id,s.store_id,s.title,CAST(s.unit_price AS CHAR) unit_price,s.revision,s.status,s.product_id,p.category_id,c.name category_name,b.barcode,CAST(s.specifications_json AS CHAR) specifications_json,COALESCE(p.description,'') description,CAST(p.images_json AS CHAR) images_json

FROM catalog_sku s LEFT JOIN catalog_product_profile p ON p.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND p.store_id=s.store_id AND p.product_id=s.product_id LEFT JOIN catalog_category c ON c.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND c.store_id=p.store_id AND c.category_id=p.category_id LEFT JOIN catalog_sku_barcode b ON b.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND b.store_id=s.store_id AND b.sku_id=s.sku_id
